sentences.text: Considering above submissions and taking note of age of victim and that till date her statement is not recorded during trial, therefore, there is a possibility that in case of bail applicant may try to influence her, prayer for bail is rejected.

10. However, the application is disposed of with direction to Trial Court to record statement of victim, if not already recorded, within a period of three months from today, if there is no other legal impediment.
Thereafter applicant is at liberty to file fresh application for bail before Trial Court.?
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that during trial statement of PWs-1 and 2 has been recorded including victim and there are material contradictions in their cross-examination.
4. Learned counsel appearing for Informant submits that victim has supported prosecution case in her examination-in-chief and survived in detailed cross-examination.
He submits that considering the nature of evidence, no case of second bail is made out.

5. Heard learned counsel for parties and perused the material available on record.
6.
The only subsequent event is the statements of PWs-1 and 2 including victim.

There is substance in the argument of learned counsel for Informant that victim has apparently supported case of prosecution, therefore, taking note of nature of allegation, no case of bail is made out.
7.

However, the application is disposed of with direction that Trial Court concerned shall take endeavour to conclude trial expeditious, preferably within a period of eight weeks from today, if there is no legal impediment.
